_README: SIMULATED pricing. Every model here runs locally on Ollama and costs $0.00 in
reality. Each local model is assigned the price tag of a commercial model of
roughly comparable capability, so that budget accounting and 'money saved'
figures are meaningful and comparable to what a real company would see.
These are ROUND, ILLUSTRATIVE numbers chosen to represent price tiers - they
are not scraped from any provider's live price list and will drift from real
prices over time. Edit them freely; because this file is in git, any change
shows up in a diff and historical results stay explainable.
_baseline_note: The model a naive 'give everyone the best' company would use. Every request records what it WOULD have cost here; that difference is the savings figure.
_ladder_note: Routable tiers, cheapest first. Routing strategies pick from this list. stable-code is excluded: it is a base completion model, not instruction-tuned, so it cannot be compared fairly on instruction-following tasks.

default.stands_in_for: unrecognised model - priced at mid tier so cost is never silently zero

qwen3:4b.stands_in_for: mid reasoning tier - output priced high because thinking tokens inflate completion length
